description: This file defines a React component called VideoPlayer that provides an enhanced video playback interface with features such as real-time emoji reactions, flying animations, sound effects, and user controls. It integrates with external services for emoji data and WebSocket communication, and manages complex animations and user interactions within a video streaming context.

methods.name: initializeAudio
methods.description: Initializes the Web Audio API context for sound effects.

methods.name: createEmojiSound
methods.description: Generates and caches an audio buffer for a given emoji sound configuration.

methods.name: playEmojiSound
methods.description: Plays the sound associated with an emoji reaction.

methods.name: handleReady
methods.description: Handles the ReactPlayer 'ready' event, updating loading state.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Handles the ReactPlayer 'start' event, updating loading state.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Sets the playing state to true.

methods.name: handlePause
methods.description: Sets the playing state to false.

methods.name: handleDuration
methods.description: Sets the total duration of the video.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between playing and pausing the video.

methods.name: handleSeek
methods.description: Seeks the video to a specific time based on user interaction.

methods.name: handleVolumeChange
methods.description: Adjusts the volume of the video player.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a time value into mm:ss string.
